title: AI agents and memory costs will decide our online share; prepare for both
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15% on memory prices; tablet shipments fell 23% (Omdia). OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet; Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spend.

points.headline: AI shopping agents are gaining checkout, payments and reach
points.detail: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent payments at retailer checkouts and Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries. We should make our checkout, listings and product data agent-ready.

points.headline: Memory prices put 2027 PC demand and tablet supply under pressure
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15%, and tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3. We should plan promo depth, mix and financing for a smaller, tighter-supplied market.

points.headline: Amazon and JD.com are reshaping product discovery and electronics channels
points.detail: Amazon plans a catalog of every product online, and JD.com is pursuing Ceconomy (MediaMarkt). We should keep our listings accurate on Amazon and watch European channel terms.

points.headline: Small business buyers are a strong holiday opening
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers during this window.
